justification: Woollahra DCP D4 Edgecliff Centre rules (12 live) were served to every Woollahra house. The chapter names its land: 'zoned E1 Local Centre under the Woollahra LEP 2014', between New South Head Rd, New McLean St, Arthur St and Ocean St (p5). Outline = the LEP E1 polygon.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The D4 keying rule or layer rule is removed or changed, or the outline file holds another id.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before: D4 rows in layer generic with no precinct id, served to every Woollahra house (DQ-143 counted 12).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Planning Portal Land Zoning E1 polygon OBJECTID 769061 (30,117 m2), Map 1 shape match 0.99; road edges New South Head Rd 280 m, New McLean St 235 m, Ocean St 195 m, Arthur St 76 m.

pre_impl.existing_data: 'New South Head Road Corridor Edgecliff' outline is chapter D2's MU1 zone and shares no land with D4. Loader profile pattern from northern_beaches.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The chapter's own lot list matches Map 1 at only 0.82 because the zone also takes in the station and bus interchange land; the E1 polygon matches at 0.99.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One outline file, a woollahra loader profile, two rules (key + layer), one test.

functions.name: apply_gate_rules
functions.input: rules woollahra_d4_layer and woollahra_d4_edgecliff_centre for council woollahra
functions.output: 14 rows keyed, 7 generic rows moved to precinct (dry run)
functions.if_none: zero matching rows means nothing is written at all

values.value: only register addresses inside: 203-233 New South Head Rd, 180 Ocean St

break_it.scenario: A Woollahra house outside Edgecliff Centre still gets D4 rules.
break_it.what_happens: Rules for the centre reach houses they do not apply to.
break_it.how: Generic rows move to the precinct layer; only lots inside the E1 outline resolve to 'Edgecliff Centre'.
break_it.repro: live for-property for 170 Ocean St Edgecliff after the write

break_it.what_happens: Centre properties lose the rules written for them.
break_it.how: Loader proof: 203-233 New South Head Rd and 180 Ocean St resolve to the outline.

break_it.scenario: use_specific rows ignore the precinct key.
break_it.what_happens: Five live use_specific rows could reach houses outside the centre.
break_it.how: Agent reports the route serves keyed use_specific rows only inside; checked live after the write.
break_it.repro: live for-property for an address outside the centre, count chapter-d4 rows

mutation_analysis: Removing either rule fails the new test.

post_merge.db_reset: Yes: import_cb_centre_boundaries.py --council woollahra --src ... --commit, then derive_precinct_keys.py --council woollahra --only woollahra_d4_layer,woollahra_d4_edgecliff_centre --apply (both write backups). Run BEFORE merge.
post_merge.manual_verify: Live: an Edgecliff Centre address gets D4 rules; 170 Ocean St does not.

residual_risk: Edgecliff Centre land outside the E1 zone, if any, is not shown D4.
